entries.title: Morning adhkar
entries.translation: We have reached the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah.

entries.title: Evening adhkar
entries.translation: We have reached the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah.

entries.title: Before sleep du'a
entries.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

entries.title: Relief from anxiety
entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-hammi wal-hazani
entries.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief.
